authorship_disclosure: Reviewer authored both harnesses and earlier checker/codec/family dependencies, not this Root saved metadata decoder. No independent mathematical implementation or replay claimed.

blockers.finding: Authentication and parsing use different reads: checked() compares pin(p) then returns Path, line24 rereads contract. Output metadata hashes envelope/plan/derived files by later reread rather than pinning exact buffers consumed/produced.
blockers.narrow_repair: Have checked/read helper return exact bounded authenticated raw bytes; parse that buffer. Derive raw file pins from retained plan_raw/outer_raw/expanded buffers (with explicit path field) that were actually parsed/decompressed/written. No proof/authority framework needed.

blockers.finding: Whole raw file is allocated by read_bytes before4MiB cap is checked; this does not independently enforce a bounded encoded intake.
blockers.narrow_repair: Use a minimal bounded cap+1 read with completeEOF predicate for encoded file, and existing reasonable bounded metadata read for plan/contract. Reject oversize before JSON/base64/decompression; preserve all failed bytes/files externally, no partial output acceptance.

checks.detail: Entire57line Source read; AST/compile only, no decoder functions/module executed.
Schema/encoding exact; duplicate keys/nonfinite rejected; full canonical outerJSON+LF.
Boolean length rejected; literal SHA256 fields bounded.
16MiB+1 bounded inflate, EOF and all tails rejected; no unbounded flush/gzip fallback.
Exact all expanded bytes including finalLF; no prefix acceptance or rehash of alternate serialization.
Explicit Source/input/purpose map join; no scientific language-binding recomputation.

checked(ref) returns a Path after pin() read; caller parses a second unverified read. Meta pin(p)/pin(plan_path) rereads files rather than pinning exact retained buffers. Thus metadata may identify different bytes from those actually parsed/decoded.

raw=p.read_bytes() precedes outer4MiB check. The encoded intake allocation itself is not bounded; plan/contract read_bytes also precede bounded parsing. Use cap+1 read and EOF, not only post-allocation length.
Derived files outside worker-owned inventory, exclusivecreation and false acceptance flags. No scientific/kernel imports; native/response/case validation remains Rootcloser.

scope_observations: This decoder checks byte-transport concordance, not complete scientific/native admission. It does not itself authenticate the ordinary response output pin/trailer or inspect full case/native/epoch evidence; Root saved closer must perform those joins separately.
Both raw buffers and decoded object currently remain untrusted metadata. No inferred currentcasecounts or promotion of old failed output actual.
No hostile OS/VM guarantee asserted; same-buffer provenance and bounded reads are direct stated transport requirements, not a new custody framework.
